app.title: FloodPath-Care
app.subtitle: Flood-aware emergency routing to maternal facilities
banner.simulation: Historical-data-informed simulation. Ambulance data is simulated. Not for live dispatch.
kpi.changed_runs: reachability changed in at least one run
card.top_origins: Origins with the largest travel-time increase
label.placeholder_weights: Population weights are placeholders (ward join failed). Coverage is a share of sample points, not of people.
result.unreachable: No suitable facility is reachable under this scenario.
note.indicative: Indicative ranking. Estimated people assume an even spread within each ward. Scenarios are not predictions. Not an operational dispatch order.
gap.facility_list: No public verified list of emergency obstetric facilities with coordinates exists for Chennai. The facility list is a hand-checked proxy.
gap.ambulance: No 108 ambulance data is public. Ambulance starts and times are simulated.
gap.peak: No open flood extent exists for the 1-4 Dec 2015 peak. The observed scenario is a composite of available layers.
gap.roads: Roads are current OpenStreetMap roads, not 2015 roads.
expl.baseline_blocked: The conventional route to {baseline_facility} crosses {n_blocked} blocked road segment(s) under the {scenario} scenario, so it is not drivable.
expl.reachable_longer: The nearest reachable facility offering {service} is {facility}, {time} minutes away, {delta} minutes longer than the conventional route.
expl.reachable_shorter: The nearest reachable facility offering {service} is {facility}, {time} minutes away, {delta} minutes shorter than the conventional route.
expl.unreachable_all: No suitable facility is reachable from this origin under the {scenario} scenario.
app.skeleton_notice: Preview skeleton: layout only, no data yet.
